angle: Unlike statement-only versions of the same node, this video runs two live batch-mean demos, flat uniform then skewed exponential, so you watch Normality emerge instead of taking it on faith.
angle_detail: Watch [01:06] through [04:04] first, since the twin demos are the entire argument and worth seeing back to back. Then take [05:12] through [06:10] for why it matters, which is how intervals and mean tests get away with ignoring the raw-data shape. Flag the inconsistency the video admits itself: the demos use batches of 20 yet the rule of thumb at [06:12] demands 30, and the only stated exception is the mean-less Cauchy case, so expect no LLN-versus-CLT separation here.
